text:
sam (product): Proposal: allow tenants to request a short-lived "temporary ceiling" on their dedicated pool throughput via Console + API. Goal: reduce SE handoffs for urgent events while protecting pool health. Looking for engineering + finance constraints.
ana (eng): A few constraints: this must be admission-only (no overcommit beyond reserve+temporary), and we need a strict TTL and per-tenant minute-level token cap.
jorge (eng-ml): From model-serving POV, please cap by RPS and token-rate, not just tokens. Models with long sequences can blow CPU/GPU memory.
mika (eng-sre): Safety controls: region-level headroom budget, per-tenant cooling windows (no back-to-back ceilings), and a global kill-switch. We'll surface alerts when region_used_temp_ceiling > 0.15 * pool_capacity.
anya (sales): Customers expect a button in Console and an email confirmation. For big accounts, we should require pre-approval before first self-serve activation. Also need an SLA note: temporary ceilings are best-effort.
billing-bot: FYI: temporary-ceiling uses same invoice line as "burst_addon" unless pre-authorized. Add billing flag preauth=true/false.
sam (product): UX: modal with: amount (tokens/min or RPS), duration (mins), preauth checkbox, and a short TOC sentence link. Include a one-click Revoke in case of abuse.
nana (eng): API sketch:
POST /v1/tenants/:tid/temporary-ceilings
body: {"rps": 50, "token_rate": 120000, "duration_mins": 60, "preauth": true}
response: {"ceiling_id": "tc_2026_01", "status": "active", "expires_at": "2026-06-10T12:34:56Z"}
Note: policy-evaluator must return admission:true/false with reason.
jorge (eng-ml): Also include a sanitized sample rate limiter rule per-model to enforce on the serving layer.
mika (eng-sre): Rollout plan:
• Phase 0: rollout Console + API behind a feature flag (internal)
• Phase 1: pilot with 4 tenants in NA (restrict total temp ceiling consumption to 8% of region capacity)
• Phase 2: expand to EU with region cap at 6%
• Phase 3: global GA with alerting and billing exports
Metrics to collect: temp_ceiling_requests, temp_ceiling_approved, temp_ceiling_rejected_reason, per_region_temp_usage_pct, revoke_events.
anya (sales): Can we add a per-tenant throttle that decays over time (e.g., if you used 100% of temp ceiling, next request needs 50% of previous max)? Helps fairness.
sam (product): Good idea. Let's call it cooldown-factor. Propose default cooldown_factor=0.5, configurable per-account. Must be in API model.
nana (eng): Implementation estimates: API + DB schema (3d), policy-evaluator hook (4d), serving-layer enforcement (3d), Console + UX (4d), telemetry and billing export (2d). Total parallelized ~3w.
mika (eng-sre): Add canary gating: default feature off; enable for pilot tenants via allowlist feature flag. Also add a dry-run mode where requests are accepted but not enforced, for 48h.
jorge (eng-ml): For serving enforcement, recommend token-bucket per-tenant-per-model with leaky behavior during ceiling window to avoid sudden OOMs.
anya (sales): Customer comms: short KB article + email template + example scenarios (traffic spikes, markdown imports, demo days). I'll draft.
billing-bot: Reminder: any preauth=true requests must create a provisional charge hold and surface acceptance in the Console before activation.
sam (product): Owners: ana -> API + schema; jorge -> serving limits + model rate-limiter; mika -> canary + alerts; anya -> KB + comms; finance to sync on provisional hold flow. Can folks ack?
nana (eng): ack, taking API/schema.
jorge (eng-ml): ack, will spec rate-limiter rules.
mika (eng-sre): ack, will own rollout gating and global kill-switch.
anya (sales): ack, will draft comms and share pilot customer names.
billing-bot: Scheduled job note: migration to add temporary_ceilings table must run during low-traffic window.
sam (product): Next steps: I'll open a PR with the API contract and proposed cooldown defaults. Sync in product sync on Friday to prioritize Jira tickets. Thanks all :)
